scene: You reach the windy catwalk, where transit lines connect across the city.
picture: Along the lighthouse catwalk, from left to right: an open rope-bridge lift car sits moored; the dark-haired boy in his green striped shirt stands holding his skateboard; a wheeled skate-park shuttle rests with its hatch open; and on the far right, a red double-decker bus idles on an elevated sky-dock platform.
shown: a swinging wooden rope-bridge lift waiting open at the platform on the far left
a yellow skate-park shuttle cart resting on rails right of the boy
a bright red double-decker bus parked at the sky-dock on the far right
